description: This file defines the EventTypesAtomService class, which manages event type operations such as retrieval, updating, and access control within a calendar or event management system. It includes methods for handling user and team event types, normalizing dates, and integrating with external app credentials.

classes.name: EventTypesAtomService
classes.description: Service class managing event type operations, including retrieval, updates, access checks, and external app integrations.

methods.name: normalizePeriodDate
methods.description: Normalizes a date input (string, Date, null, or undefined) to a Date object set to UTC midnight, handling timezone shifts.

methods.name: getTeamSlug
methods.description: Retrieves the slug for a team given its ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getUserEventType
methods.description: Fetches a specific event type for a user, checking permissions and filtering team members.

methods.name: getUserEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all event types associated with a user.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all event types associated with a team.

methods.name: updateTeamEventType
methods.description: Updates a team event type, normalizing date fields and checking permissions.

methods.name: updateEventType
methods.description: Updates an event type, normalizing date fields and checking permissions.

methods.name: checkCanUpdateTeamEventType
methods.description: Checks if a user can update a specific team event type, considering organization admin status and team ownership.

methods.name: checkTeamOwnsEventType
methods.description: Verifies if a team owns a specific event type, throws ForbiddenException if not.

methods.name: getEventTypesAppIntegration
methods.description: Retrieves app integration details for event types, including credentials and dependencies.

methods.name: getUserPaymentInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed payment info for a user, including event type and booking details.

methods.name: bulkUpdateEventTypesDefaultLocation
methods.description: Bulk updates default location for multiple event types.

methods.name: bulkUpdateTeamEventTypesDefaultLocation
methods.description: Bulk updates default location for multiple team event types.

methods.name: getPublicEventTypeForAtoms
methods.description: Retrieves the public event type for atoms, handling both team and user events, with fallback for profile-based retrieval.
